assertions.text: Uses gh pr edit --remove-label "s: codex review bypassed" followed by gh pr edit --add-label "s: codex review bypassed", not a single --add-label call
Explicitly states that a plain --add-label on an already-present label is a silent GitHub no-op that would not re-trigger publish's re-evaluation
Resolves owner/repo from the PR's own url field, never a separate gh repo view
Resolves the actor via gh api user --jq '.login' and verifies permission via gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/collaborators/{actor}/permission

Writes the reason text to a scratchpad file via Write, then builds the marker JSON via jq -n --rawfile reason <path> --arg actor ... --arg head_sha ... --arg created_at ..., never composing the reason into a Bash command string
Posts via gh pr comment --body-file, not an inline --body with interpolated text
States it does not poll for the re-triggered check's completion, unlike merge-pr's version
